title: PacBio Library Preparation for Scapharca broughtonii
author: Chang-Ming CM Bai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z76f9re
materials: The concerntration and size were detected with Qubit 3.0 (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., Carlsbad, CA, USA) and Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 system (Agilent Technologies, Palo Alto, CA, USA).

steps.title: Fragment Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Fragment the genomic DNA using a g-TUBE (Covaris, Brighton, UK) to obtain ~20kb fragments.

substeps.instruction: Verify fragment sizes using an Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 system (Agilent Technologies, Palo Alto, CA, USA), ensuring main fragments are >17 Kb.

steps.title: Perform End-repair and Adaptor-ligation
steps.instruction: Carry out end-repair and adaptor-ligation using the SMRTbell Template Prep Kit (Pacific Biosciences, p/n 100-259-100).

substeps.instruction: Perform damage repair at 37℃ for 60 min.
Perform end repair at 25℃ for 10 min.

steps.title: Size-select and Purify Fragments
steps.instruction: Select fragments within the 12-50 kb size range and purify them.

substeps.instruction: Use the BluePippin Size-Selection system (Sage Science, Beverly, the U.S.) for size selection.
Purify the selected fragments using AMPure PB beads (Agencourt, Beverly, the U.S.).

steps.title: Re-repair and Purify Fragments
steps.instruction: Re-repair the purified fragments and perform a second purification.

substeps.instruction: Use the SMRTbell Damage Repair Kit (Pacific Biosciences, p/n 100-465-900) for re-repair.
Purify the fragments using AMPure PB beads.

steps.title: Prepare Final Library for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Combine qualified fragments with necessary reagents using the PacBio Binding Kit (Pacific Biosciences, p/n 100-372-700).

substeps.instruction: Add primers, polymerase, and Magbeads (Pacific Biosciences, p/n 100-676-500).
